name: CurveBurner
fix_description: In execute(), set a proper min_amount_out when performing swaps instead of hardcoding 0. Calculate the minimum acceptable output based on oracle price or a reasonable slippage tolerance to prevent sandwich attacks from extracting value.
difficulty_reasoning: The PoC is a very short, direct attack: buy a token, call a vulnerable convertAndBurn function once with a crafted token array including address(0), then swap back for profit. It uses only simple Uniswap swaps and one protocol-specific call, with no complex flash-loan logic, accounting manipulation, or multi-contract state reasoning.
